quirks.summary: The pl-bs host serves both the planning register and building standards; /online-applications/ is the planning one.
quirks.detail: Confirmed 2026-09-30: breadcrumb 'Planning applications' and references of the /PP (planning permission) and /AD (advertisement) forms. Note PlanIt's fuzzy auths match for 'Renfrewshire' ALSO returns East Renfrewshire's BUILDING STANDARDS register (ercbuildingstandards.eastrenfrewshire.gov.uk/buildingstandards/) - a different council and the wrong register.
quirks.workaround: Check the breadcrumb and the reference suffix before trusting a PlanIt row for this name.
